PublicOciProvenance.description:
Registry provenance re-presented publicly, carrying identity without location.

A registry host and repository path name Nscale's own infrastructure, so a published card states
what the artifact is and not where it is kept. This is a separate variant rather than nullable
fields on `OciProvenance` so a public projection *cannot* carry a location by construction, and
so a stored artifact can never validate without one.
PublicOciProvenance.title: PublicOciProvenance

UnreferencedOpaqueSecret.description:
One IMS-provisioned Secret deployment that no readable model in scope references.

The customer request id is deliberately absent: it is only knowable from the referencing BYOM
configuration, and reading the Secret's own configuration would materialize its raw value.

role.description: Role read from the published reference; absent whenever secret_ref is.

secret_ref.description: Logical reference the Secret published. Absent while it is still deploying, when nothing has been published and the Secret is matched on the reference either role would fix for its id.
secret_ref.title: Secret Ref

UnreferencedOpaqueSecret.title: UnreferencedOpaqueSecret
